item.title: Minister Inaugurates Power Pavilion At IITF
item.description: Minister of State for Power Shripad Y. Naik inaugurated the Ministry of Power pavilion at the 44th India International Trade Fair in New Delhi.

item.title: Tsuyo Signs LoI with Karnataka Govt For Setting Up Manufacturing Plant
item.description: Electric mobility manufacturer Tsuyo Manufacturing announced the signing of a LoI with the government of Karnataka for setting up a state-of-the-art manufacturing plant along with a large testing track for commercial vehicles.

item.title: Tata Power and DGPC Sign Agreement For Hydro Project
item.description: Tata Power Company announced that it has signed a commercial agreement with Bhutan’s Druk Green Power Corporation Limited for the implementation of 1,125 MW Dorjilung hydropower project.

item.title: Government Amends Petroleum And Natural Gas Rules
item.description: Government of India amended the Petroleum and Natural Gas Rules, 2025, to boost ease of doing business as well as strengthening exploration and production infrastructure.

item.title: Nuclear Reforms Will Accelerate Development Of Rare Metals: Dr Jitendra Singh
item.description: Union Minister of State for Science & Technology, Earth Sciences Dr. Jitendra Singh said in parliament that development of rare earth metals in the country will be accelerated due to the recent nuclear reforms, including measures under the Shanti Act.

item.title: ‘Ingersoll Rand Is Rapidly Scaling Solar, Onsite Renewables, And Green Power Contracts’
item.description: n an interaction with Energy Today, Mr. Vedamurthy Mallikarjunaswamy, Product Management Leader, Ingersoll Rand India, talks about the company's role in green energy.

item.title: PNGRB Waives Imbalance Charges Due To Gulf Uncertanities
item.description: Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board has waived the imbalance charges that were applicable to its various entities, shippers and consumers.

item.title: Maiden Edition of Bharat Electricity Summit Gets Underway
item.description: The maiden edition of ‘Bharat Electricity Summit’, a four-day global conference-cum-exhibition for the power sector, got going on 19 March, 2026 at the Yashobhoomi Convention Center in Delhi.

item.title: Union Power Minister Chairs Ministerial Meet At Bharat Electricity Summit 2026
item.description: Union Power Minister Manohar Lal chaired a ministerial meet on the second day of the Bharat Electricity Summit where he called for coordinated efforts between Center and states.

item.title: Freyr Collaborates With Dhurandar 2 To Highlight AI-Powered Innovation
item.description: Rooftop solar company Freyr Energy announced a collaboration with Ranveer Singh’s hit film Dhurandar 2 to highlight its flagship innovation that is India’s first AI-powered intelligent self-cleaning solar technology.
